name: sheet
title: Sheet
description: A bottom sheet that rises over its nearest positioned ancestor: a modal dialog with a backdrop, a grab bar, a header of close or expand plus a centered title and optional Done, and a scrolling body. The drawer lifts a short way from the bottom on open and slides back out on dismissal; dragging the grab bar stretches the panel in place, bottom edge pinned, into a filled extra-details surface over the same ancestor. Pass modal={false} for a contained extra-details surface that leaves surrounding chrome reachable.
